channel.title: Skill on Engineering Docs
channel.description: Recent content in Skill on Engineering Docs

item.title: Skill: Doc Producer
item.description: Produces post-ship documentation for a completed feature: updated service page, new runbooks, and onboarding updates.

item.title: Skill: PRD Writer
item.description: Translates a feature brief into a structured Product Requirements Document.

item.title: Skill: QA Reviewer
item.description: Cross-references a feature's PRD, implementation, and test scenarios to produce a gap analysis with a clear Approve/Block verdict.

item.title: Skill: Retrospective
item.description: Facilitates a blameless written retrospective for a completed feature.

item.title: Skill: System Designer
item.description: Produces a draft ADR and architecture design from an approved PRD.

item.title: Skill: Test Case Writer
item.description: Writes acceptance test scenarios for a completed implementation.

item.title: Skill: Ticket Definer
item.description: Breaks an approved PRD and merged ADR into GitHub Issues ready for development.
